{{Quote|My soldiers are exhausted ... I took the credits from Granta in order to feed and clothe them. I did not want to fight the Jedi. I do not want to fight at all, actually ... My lungs are full of smoke and ashes.|Captain Noq Welflet, commander of troops in Haariden's civil war, to Jedi Masters Kenobi and [[Soara Antana/Legends|Soara Antana]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref>}}
'''Noq Welflet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who led his troops in battle among the warring tribes of [[Haariden]] during the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], Welflet took payment from [[Granta Omega]] to hunt down [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in exchange for food and clothing for his beleaguered soldiers. In turn, Welflet opened fire on Kenobi's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team who were [[Mission to Haariden|sent to rescue]] a group of scientists, who had discovered for themselves a holdout in the besieged countryside village of [[Tenuuri]].

Believing that Omega had lied to him and his men, the gaunt and weary Welflet ordered a cease-fire to allow the Jedi to escape from the planet with the scientists they'd rescued.

In the end, when the Jedi returned to Haariden in their renewed pursuit of Omega, the overproud Welflet and his troops, despite Kenobi's warnings to evacuate, were caught in the [[Kaachtari]] volcano eruption that caused a massive landslide of rock and lava, killing them all.
